summary: Worker Home Distance feature + click safety validated. Backend regression on /api/jobs/vacancies green (3/3 pytest). Frontend: distance row renders as 'X.X km away' when worker geolocation is granted AND job has lat/lng; hidden gracefully when either is missing (no crash, no console errors). Card-body tap navigates to /job/{id}; Apply Now tap only submits application (no double-navigation). AI Match card updates summary text on tap. Skill chip filter works, no crash on rapid changes. Client Home still shows enriched N Required / M Remaining / K Selected chips. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected. Only pre-existing 'shadow*' style-prop deprecation warning surfaced (not related to this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: home.tsx uses a Pressable wrapping the card whose onPress fires router.push(/job/{id}); the Apply Now PrimaryButton is a nested Pressable and correctly stops propagation in RN — verified live that Apply does NOT bubble to card. Safe as-is.
Minor: locStatus state is defined with only a setter destructure ('const [, setLocStatus]'). Consider removing state entirely if never read, or exposing it for a UI banner. Not blocking.
Minor: applyNow silently swallows errors (catch {}). A future improvement could surface a toast (already noted as TODO in code).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 flows: distance-visible, distance-hidden-no-geo, distance-hidden-no-coords, card-tap-nav, apply-no-double-nav, ai-match, chip-filter, client-enriched-chips)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 real job via POST /api/jobs as client 9000000001 with lat=28.6139, lng=77.2090 (title 'ITER42_DELHI_GPS_1786462338', id ca0abb34-8d33-47d8-a955-f05bc64548c6). Applied to one slot as worker to verify Apply flow. Test data prefixed TEST_iter42/ITER42 for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Distance-row selector: cards render text 'Distance' + 'X.X km away' inside [data-testid^=vacancy-]. Fresh-browser no-geo test relies on context.clear_permissions() before login; the useEffect in home.tsx swallows permission errors silently. Vacancy testids are 'vacancy-<vacancy_key>' where vacancy_key = short hex slot key (e.g. 'a45d45ac2c8f'), NOT the job UUID. The full job UUID is only accessible via item.id inside the component. Apply testid = 'vacancy-apply-<vacancy_key>'.
